project_type: Next.js 16.3.3 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase SSR
build_system: Next.js with npm scripts. No separate compile step — `npm run build` runs the full Next.js production build including TypeScript checking.
test_framework: None — no test runner configured. Verification is `npm run lint` + `npm run build`.
verification_instructions: Run `cd c:\website\GrooveSystem && npm run lint` first to catch ESLint issues, then `npm run build` for TypeScript and production build checks. Both must exit 0. No dev server restarts needed.
environment_constraints: All pages are 'use client' with browser Supabase client (createClient from @/lib/supabase/client). Server actions use 'use server'. cookies() is async (Next.js 16). Never modify the DB schema unnecessarily. No test framework to run. The project root is c:\website\GrooveSystem — NOT groove-next.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md warns this is Next.js 16 with breaking changes. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for API details. All existing Supabase integrations, auth, and UI conventions must be preserved.
key_patterns: Design tokens: bg-card, bg-muted, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, text-accent-text, border-border, border-divider, bg-accent, bg-accent-soft, text-accent-foreground, border-accent-border. Custom classes: g-card, g-pill, g-pill-accent, g-eyebrow, g-input, g-skeleton, g-header, g-header-inner, g-hsearch, g-header-link, g-header-brand, g-sheet-link, g-panel, g-menu-item. Utility: cn() from @/components/shared/cn. All profile pages are 'use client' with useEffect data loading. Achievement hooks: useAchievements(userId, role) → {achievements, loading, error, refetch}; useBadgeStatus(userId) → {badgeStatus, loading, error, refetch}. Badge image canonical path: /image/Badge/Groove-BADGE.png (NOT /image/Groove-BADGE.svg which does not exist).
directory_structure: c:\website\GrooveSystem is the project root (NOT groove-next). Key dirs: app/(client)/client/ — client routes; app/(coach)/coach/ — coach routes; components/achievements/ — all achievement UI; components/shared/ — AppTopNav, DashboardLayout, StatCard, EmptyState; components/client/ — ClientLayout, navigation; components/coach/ — CoachLayout, navigation; lib/achievements/ — types, hooks, server/client services; lib/supabase/ — client.ts and server.ts; app/actions/ — server actions; public/image/Badge/Groove-BADGE.png — badge image (confirmed present).
